title: Logging Out from Zscaler While Using SAML

blocks.text: You can choose from a variety of methods to log out of Zscaler to trigger reauthentication for users who are using SAML with auto-provisioning or Hosted DB authentication. You should also choose one of the following methods if SCIM is not supported for the identity provider (IdP) server being used.

These methods only apply if you are forwarding traffic using PAC files and using cookie-based authentication. If you are using Zscaler Client Connector, see Using Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more about cookie-based authentication, see About Zscaler Cookies.
To log out from Zscaler, choose one of the following methods:

blocks.item: Log Out the User from Zscaler
To trigger reauthentication for the user, see ip.zscaler.com and click Logout.
Delete the Zscaler Cookies from the Browser
To learn more about Zscaler's cookies, see About Zscaler Cookies.
Delete the User from the Zscaler Admin Console
From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Users.
On the Users tab, select the user that you want to delete by clicking the Edit icon for the selected user.
Click Delete to delete the user.
Use CSV Import to Delete the User from the Zscaler Database
To learn more about CSV Import, see Importing User Details from a CSV File.
